messages.content:
Two readers answered the same question about machines at work. Reader A used facts taken from a fact
store; each fact comes with the sentence it was taken from. Reader B read the documents directly and points at
sentences. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When the two rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- If reader B found nothing, decide only whether A's evidence really states A's answer for the exact subject.
- "same" means the two answers say the same thing. "neither" means neither answer is supported.
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": "A" | "B" | "same" | "neither"}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which conformity assessment procedures can the manufacturer choose for machinery listed in Annex I, Part A?

Answer A: ["module B followed by module C", "module H", "module G"]
For machinery in categories listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer shall apply one of the procedures in Article 25(2): module B followed by module C, module H (full quality assurance), or module G (unit verification).
Evidence of A:
- manufacturer: hasObligation = shall apply one of the following procedures (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures:" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX;" [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X." [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- category of machinery or related product: requiresProcedure = EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII (condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A) | sentence: "(a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII;" [REG, Art. 25(2)]

Answer B: ["EU type-examination (module B) followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C)", "conformity based on full quality assurance (module H)", "conformity based on unit verification (module G)"]
Under Article 25(2) of the Regulation, machinery in Annex I, Part A must follow one of three procedures: module B followed by module C, module H, or module G.
Evidence of B:
- Read on demand: REG, Art. 25(2) | sentence: "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X." [REG, Art. 25(2)]

response.text: {"reasoning": "Both answers list the same three procedures (module B followed by C, module H, module G), and the quoted Article 25(2) sentence states exactly those three options for machinery in Annex I, Part A. Reader A's evidence is the same text split into four facts, and Reader B quotes the full provision. The choice is therefore \"same\".", "choice": "same"}
